title: CLI: append to issue description (update --append-description)
description:
Add `pebbles update --append-description <TEXT>` (long flag only; no short form) to append TEXT to the issue description instead of replacing it with -d/--description.

Semantics (pure helper append_description, unit-testable without I/O, modeled on add_tags_to_issue):
- no current description -> TEXT (verbatim)
- current description ends with a newline -> current + TEXT
- otherwise -> current + "\n" + TEXT (append a line)
- appending the empty string is a no-op: no file write, no jj commit, "No changes: nothing to update" (pebble e74 no-op discipline)

Combination rule: -d/--description sets the description first, then --append-description appends to that result. Multi-ID/stdin input, per-ID failure summary, and exit codes are unchanged (r[bulk-input], r[bulk-fail-soft]).

Implementation plan: pure fn + thin operations shell (update gains the append parameter), CLI flag in src/cli.rs (Update command), SPEC CLI bullet + README Quick Start update-issues section, unit tests, and a trycmd fixture test tests/cmd/update-append (in/out dirs, .no_jj per tests/cli_tests.rs) asserting screen output and the resulting description.

Reference: user requested 2026-09-24 ("option to from the CLI append something to the description").
